summary: Generate Rust cells with explicit Result and String guidance

delivery.outcome: Give Rust generation explicit idiomatic guidance for its existing Result return type and String pattern matching, based on retained compiler failures.
nonGoals: No contract, oracle, type or implementation patching by the operator
No inference budget increase, provider retry change or business-rule hints
No edits to standard release fields or another writer scope

architecture.decision: Clarify the Rust language instructions in the existing standalone cell prompt. Validate by the real compiler and trusted package oracle rather than literal-string unit tests.
architecture.rollback: Independently reviewed revert; retain raw proposal/audit evidence.

validation.evidence: Existing package/adapter tests preserve contract/type/example context and prohibit changes outside the single implementation.
At most three fresh whole-file Rust proposals; actual compiler/oracle determines acceptance; retained failure logs and no manual function edits.
Required local/native/governance checks and independent exact-head publication; accepted package bundle/clone and application verification when produced.
